text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0825 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne lower on follow through selling and on dry weekend weather on the Prairies. November WCE canola crush profit margins rose to -6.95 Friday from -10.14 Thursday. Canada's dollar opened flat at C$1.3847, rose to 84.46 yen and steady at 1.3293 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$0.50 to C$1.00 down on spill over pressure.
WESTERN BARLEY - C$0.30 to C$0.80 a tonne lower on CBOT corn calls and last week's Canadian Wheat Board Pool Return Outlook price forecast set a C$5 a tonne drop in feed barley.
FEED WHEAT - C$0.30 to C$0.80 down on CBOT wheat and corn calls and the CWB's July PROs which set a C$6 to C$9 a tonne fall in world wheat prices.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
